measures.notes: Riverside County ROV (voteinfo.net, the lead county) publishes only a Notice of Election for Measure B; the resolution, full text, impartial analysis (by Riverside County Counsel, Riverside letterhead), tax rate statement and argument in favor are published on the San Bernardino County ROV measures page (Beaumont USD apparently has territory/voters in SB County too). County page states: No Argument Against was filed (so no rebuttals). 55% vote, $86M bonds. RES_BUSD is an unsigned 'Stradling Draft of 5/20/26' with blank resolution number. AF_BUSD is a scan with a poor OCR layer, rendered text readable as 'Argument in Favor of Measure B'.
